rows.value:
Total supports 3 x M.2 socket and 8x SATA III (6Gb/s) ports
 
Intel 12th/13th/14th Processors
 
1 x M.2 (M Key) Socket (M2-PCIE4_64G_1)
 
Supports M.2 Type 2280 SSD module
 
Supports PCIe 4.0 x 4 (64Gb/s)
 
Intel Z690 Chipset
 
1 x M.2 (M Key) Socket (M2_PCIE4_64G_2):
 
Supports M.2 Type 2280 SSD module
 
Supports PCIe 4.0 x 4 (64Gb/s)
 
Supports Intel Rapid Storage Technology and Intel Optane Technology
 
1 x M.2 (M Key) Socket (M2_PCIEG3_32G_SATA_1):
 
Supports M.2 Type 2242/ 2260/ 2280/ 22110 SSD module
 
Supports PCIe 3.0 x 4 (32Gb/s) & SATA lll (6Gb/s) SSD
 
Supports Intel Rapid Storage Technology and Intel Optane Technology
 
8 x SATA III Connector (6Gb/s): Supports AHCI, RAID 0, 1, 5, 10 (Support Only SATA_1~SATA_4) & Intel Rapid Storage Technology
 
 
* When using SATA SSD module on M.2 Socket (M2_PCIEG3_32_SATA_1), the SATA_8 connector will be disabled.
 
** When using PCIE SSD module on M.2 Socket (M2_PCIEG4_64G_2), the PCIEG4X4 slot will be disabled.
